name: dragonmaw_illusion_male
_comment: Male Dragonmaw Illusion (creature 23130): standard orc male in the red orc skin (colour 10), bare with the colour-10 pelvis cloth like the stock fel orc look. Replaces fel orc display 21267, whose race 12 now draws worgen skins. Colour 10's CharSections underwear names OrcMaleNakedPelvisSkin00_101, which no client ships; the HD pack's _10 is used.
